events.verdict: Doncic (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact during the drive and shot attempt by James (LAL).
Howard (LAL) makes incidental contact with Doncic (DAL) as both players go for the loose ball on the rebound.
Bradley (LAL) and Curry (DAL) both have their hands on the ball and a held ball is whistled.
Powell (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Davis (LAL) in the post.
Powell (DAL) establishes himself in a screening position in Bradley's (LAL) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
During the rebound, Powell (DAL) and Howard (LAL) engage and disengage and then Powell makes incidental contact to James (LAL) that does not affect his ability to control the ball.
Powell (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Davis (LAL) in the post.
Davis (LAL) makes inadvertent contact with Powell's (DAL) lower body as part of a natural shooting motion.
Green (LAL) and Porzingis (DAL) make incidental contact during the rebound.
Powell (DAL) establishes himself in a screening position in James' (LAL) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Doncic (DAL) and Davis (LAL) make incidental contact with each other off ball.
Davis (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position and gives Finney-Smith (DAL) room to avoid the contact.
Bradley (LAL) establishes himself in a screening position in Finney-Smith's (DAL) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Caruso (LAL) establishes himself in a legal guarding position when Doncic (DAL) grabs the rebound, but Doncic does not go through him and dislodge him from his position.
Davis (LAL) makes contact to Doncic's (DAL) arm and pulls his hand away from the ball during the start of his dribble.
James (LAL) makes contact to Powell's (DAL) arm after he receives the pass.
Howard (LAL) grabs and holds Curry (DAL) and delays his effort to contest the jump shot by Green (LAL).
Curry (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Green (LAL).
